name: Folio
description: An eternally simple, paper-thin design system built on warm neutrals, hairline borders, and editorial serif headlines.
concept: Folio treats the page like a single well-printed leaf of paper. A warm bone background carries a pure white surface card, set with a high-contrast serif display and a quiet sans body. Hairline borders carry the structure, ink-black pill buttons carry the action, and one small four-point star carries the brand. Nothing decorates what does not need decoration.

palette.name: Bone
palette.role: Primary page background — warm paper neutral that frames every surface.

palette.name: Snow
palette.role: Card and panel surface — pure white set against bone for soft depth.

palette.name: Ink
palette.role: Primary text, primary button fill, and the four-point brand mark.

palette.name: Stone
palette.role: Secondary text, captions, helper copy, and inactive icons.

palette.name: Mist
palette.role: Hairline borders, dividers, input outlines, and quiet separators.

palette.name: Whisper
palette.role: Subtle hover states, zebra rows, and gentle infill panels.

fonts.name: Instrument Serif
fonts.usage: Display and editorial headlines — high contrast serif used at large sizes for marquee statements.

fonts.name: System UI
fonts.usage: Body copy, UI labels, buttons, inputs, and all small text. Native UI faces avoid another font request and feel at home on the reader's platform.

iconPack.name: Lucide
iconPack.usage: One consistent outline weight for interface, action, and feature icons. Stroked in Ink, sized at 16-20px to sit quietly next to body copy.
